## Product Categories & What Sells Best in Nigeria (Based on 10+ Years of Sales Data)
### Door Locks (45% of our total lock sales)
- Mortise locks (best seller: $3.00-$6.00 price range, single cylinder, satin nickel finish)
- Padlocks (best seller: 50mm standard padlocks, $1.00-$3.00 price range)
- Stainless steel padlocks for coastal areas (Lagos, Port Harcourt)
- Smart locks (growing fast in Lagos and Abuja high-end estates)
- Replacement lock cylinders (for replacement market, 10% of our sales)

### Door Handles (50% of our total handle sales)
- Zinc alloy handles (best seller: $1.50-$5.00 price range, satin nickel finish, lever style - 75% of our handle sales)
- Stainless steel handles (SS201 for inland areas like Abuja/Kano, SS304 for coastal Lagos/Port Harcourt)
- Aluminum handles (modern style, popular in new estates)

### Door Hinges
- Butt hinges, spring hinges, T-hinges (stainless steel for coastal areas)

### Sliding Tracks
- Drawer slides, sliding door tracks, barn door hardware

### Other Products
- Cabinet hardware, furniture fittings, building materials, door accessories

## FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions from Nigerian Importers)
### Q: What hardware sells best in Nigeria?
A: Mortise locks ($3.00-$6.00) and 50mm padlocks ($1.00-$3.00) are our top sellers, based on 10+ years of sales data. Satin nickel is the most popular finish.

### Q: What's the difference between SS201 and SS304 for Nigeria?
A: SS201 is good for inland areas like Abuja and Kano (dry climate). SS304 is a must for coastal areas like Lagos and Port Harcourt, otherwise it will rust.

### Q: Do you handle SONCAP and Form M?
A: Yes! We handle 100% of SONCAP documentation for our Nigerian clients for FREE, and we can guide you through Form M process.

### Q: Can I mix different products in one container?
A: Yes! We accept mixed container orders.

### Q: Do you offer free samples?
A: Yes! We offer free samples, you only pay for shipping.

### Q: What payment terms do you accept?
A: Standard is T/T (30% deposit, 70% against B/L copy). L/C for orders over $50k.
